new_findings.defect: The derived profile rule says only '148 labelled images from 150 hand-tagged images'; its caveat says the metrics are in-sample but does not identify the two detector-missed labels or state their exclusion policy, unlike the calibration manifest.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A consumer reproducing profile calibration from v3r alone cannot distinguish detector misses from missing or invalid labels and may count the metrics as covering a different labelled population.
new_findings.fix: Add the two no-signal IDs, their one-positive/one-negative split, and the exclusion-not-negative policy to v3r's calibrated_on/caveat metadata or link the calibration record explicitly.
